description: Dependency update pull requests for wordpress-nginx: GitHub Actions and the tools the workflows install, the Dockerfiles' base images, the third-party images the chart pins, the documentation site's npm packages. WordPress and Dragonfly have their own workflows (wp-version-check.yml, dragonfly-version-check.yml). tests/ci/test.sh guards what the bot updates and what stays manual.

helm-values.description: The image pins of the chart's own values file only, not of examples or fixtures.

helmv3.description: The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases.

customManagers.description: Tool versions of the workflows, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.
The search sidecar's image tag, at both of its spots in chart/Chart.yaml: the tag the templates read and the entry of the images list.
The k3s image the page Try it locally creates its k3d cluster with; try-locally.yml runs the page's command. Only releases: no rc tags, no tags of one architecture.

packageRules.description: Release tags of the pinned tools carry a v prefix, the pins do not.
A new digest under the same version means a release tag was moved: approve it on the dashboard after a look at the commit.
The Renovate that renovate-config.yml runs, once a month: Renovate releases most days.

prBodyNotes: The job `hadolint` fails until `HADOLINT_SHA256` in .github/workflows/docker-test.yml is the sum of `hadolint-linux-x86_64` in https://github.com/hadolint/hadolint/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/checksums.sha256.

packageRules.description: The k3d of the job try-locally.yml; its pull request runs that job.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/try-locally/test.sh fails until "Tested with k3d …" in examples/k3d/README.md names it.

packageRules.description: The k3s of the page Try it locally; its pull request runs the job try-locally.yml.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/try-locally/test.sh fails until "Tested with k3d … and k3s …" in examples/k3d/README.md names it.

packageRules.description: Dragonfly has its own workflow, dragonfly-version-check.yml: it proposes a version only after a container has started with the flags the chart passes.
A change to an image the chart runs by default is a change to the chart.
prBodyNotes: This changes an image the chart pins: add a line under `## Unreleased` in chart/CHANGELOG.md before merging.

packageRules.description: A new MariaDB series upgrades the data directory of an existing installation on its first start: a deliberate move, approved on the dashboard.

The base image is a moving tag on purpose: every release build pulls it afresh, and with it the current PHP patch release. Its tag changes only for a new PHP series, a deliberate move, approved on the dashboard.
prBodyNotes: A new PHP series in the image: add a line under `## Unreleased` in chart/CHANGELOG.md, and build the image and run docker/tests/smoke-test.sh before merging.

packageRules.description: A new major of any other image pin or base image waits for approval on the dashboard.
The documentation site's npm packages (site/), once a month; its pull requests build the site.
